paragraphs: Client Profile
Which of the key contacts listed above will likely serve as project sponsor? Project manager?
JAGGAER Sales Team
Partners (IF APPLICABLE)

sections.title: Client Business Drivers and Sales insights
paragraphs: Provide an overview of the client’s current business process, including specific pain points.
How will the scoped solution address the client’s pain points?
Has the client defined specific goals? If so, what are they?
Was a Value Assessment or Supplier Assessment completed for the client? If so, attach.

Did JAGGAER respond to an RFP as part of this sale? If so, attach the RFP responses. Note that our implementation will align with the Statement of Work, not the RFP, but it is sometimes helpful to see the RFP as we learn about the client.
What was demonstrated to the client as part of the sales process?
What commitments were made to deliver product or integration features not available today?

sections.title: Client ERP and Technology
paragraphs: What is the client’s current ERP and version?
Does the client have other systems we should be aware of? For example, a facilities management or contract authoring solution. If so, what are they?
Are any of these systems “home-grown” or highly modified from the standard versions?

sections.title: Client Team
paragraphs: If E-Procurement and Accounts Payable are part of this project, how are those groups organized? Do they have the same reporting hierarchy, or are they managed separately?
How does the client procure technical resources to deliver integrations? For example, dedicated team, request from a pool, etc.
Do members of the client team communicate closely with other clients?

sections.title: Project Guidance
paragraphs: When does the client want to start the project?
When does the client want to go live?
What are the Top 3 risks to the implementation project?
Do members of the client team communicate closely with other clients?
Do you have any travel recommendations? Hotels, airports, client sensitivities, etc.
What other information should the Professional Services team understand to be successful?
